selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 blocked from exchanging traffic directly (post-fix)
selected_evidence.summary: Persistent nftables rules installed on node2 (drop to/from 10.100.118.12) and node3 (drop to/from 10.100.118.11); subsequent pings node2->node3 and node3->node2 both showed 100% packet loss.

selected_evidence.requirement: Both node2 and node3 continue to reach node1 after isolation applied
selected_evidence.summary: node2->node1 and node3->node1 pings succeeded with 0% loss; node1->node2 and node1->node3 pings also succeeded, confirming bidirectional node1 reachability was preserved.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, and post-restart recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 2b666fc9-... captured; native `reboot` issued; after SONiC cold boot completed, boot_id changed to c0f7db9e-... (later 0ea6.. confirmed again after node3 restart cross-check); all SONiC docker containers (database, swss, bgp, syncd, teamd, radv, gbsyncd, sysmgr, eventd) reported Up and node1 could ping both node2 and node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, and post-restart recovery of isolation + node1 reachability
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 92ec88af-... captured; native `reboot` issued; new boot_id 491a1af2-... confirmed on recovery; nftables.service active with isolation rule intact from /etc/nftables.conf; node2->node3 blocked, node2->node1 reachable.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, and post-restart recovery of isolation + node1 reachability
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 242af11e-... captured; native `reboot` issued; new boot_id 0ea643d5-... confirmed on recovery; nftables.service active with isolation rule intact; node3->node2 blocked, node3->node1 reachable.

selected_evidence.requirement: Restarts performed one node at a time with quorum/independent recovery path preserved throughout
selected_evidence.summary: node1 was restarted and fully verified before node2 was restarted; node2 was restarted and fully verified before node3 was restarted; no two nodes were down concurrently.
